subject: MAP: runway-to-reserve — Oakbridge capacity & acceptance cadence
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@oakbridgehealth.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@oakbridgehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: MAP + capacity cadence for Oakbridge pilot

Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency profile on streaming and the model-variant fallbacks. We've put together a draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) that ties evaluation milestones to capacity reservation steps. High level asks:

- Hold a 4-week eval window (pilot) on a dedicated tranche (H100-equivalent) to validate end-to-end throughput for clinical summarization workloads.
- Reserve ability to scale to a 32-GPU pool (H100) within 8 weeks post-PO for production cutover.
- Acceptance criteria: p95 inference latency <220ms on 4k-seq, 99.5% success rate for KV cache warm-starts, and pass SOC2 evidence checks we outlined.

Can you confirm Redwood's expected procurement lead time for a 32-GPU private pool and whether we can stage an initial 8-GPU dev tranche while the full pool is provisioned? Attached is Oakbridge_MAP_v2.pdf and a preliminary sizing workbook.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Oakbridge Health — Director, ML Platforms

Attachments referenced: Oakbridge_MAP_v2.pdf, gpu-sizing-sheet.xlsx

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@oakbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@oakbridgehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: MAP + capacity cadence for Oakbridge pilot

Sanjay — thanks for the clear MAP. High level answers inline:

- Procurement/Provisioning lead time for a 32-GPU private pool (on customer VPC) is typically 6–10 weeks depending on region and KMS/HSM integrations.
- Yes, we can stage an 8-GPU dev tranche (H100 or equivalent A100-80GB mix) within 1–2 weeks once the order is accepted — that's our common approach to unblock evals.
- We'll bake the acceptance criteria into the MAP; SOC2 evidence collection and audit log export will be part of the onboarding checklist.

Next steps I propose:
1) Sign the MAP v2 (we can accept via DocuSign) — target 06/08
2) Provision 8-GPU tranche for pilot start 06/15
3) Run 4-week eval, collect latency/cost baselines, then ramp to 32 GPUs 8 weeks after PO

Looping in Laura Bennett (Onboarding) and Ben Carter (Customer Success) to confirm runbooks and any additional gating items.

— Mateo

On attachments: please add a short list of prioritized prompts and a representative workload CSV so our sizing sheet reflects real per-seq costs.

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: MAP + capacity cadence for Oakbridge pilot

Thanks for the tag — quick internal notes for the MAP and sizing workbook (internal only):

- For the 8->32 GPU runway we should propose a mixed-quantization strategy: 8 dev GPUs on fp16 to preserve latency and accuracy; recommend quantized int8 variants for the 32-GPU prod tranche to reduce cost by ~2.3x while keeping quality within the MAP's regression tolerance.
- Lead time assumptions: 8 GPU dev tranche = 7–14 days; 32 GPU private pool = 6–10 weeks (matches Mateo). If Oakbridge requires HSM/KMS onboarding for keys, add ~2 weeks.
- Acceptance test plan: we'll run a 3-stage gate: functional correctness (prompt set), load/slo (p95/p99), and production failover (fallback variant + region failover).

I'll attach a condensed acceptance-test-plan.docx and a runbook excerpt to include in the MAP. Ben — can you confirm CS support for the 4-week eval and assign an Engineer to run weekly checkpoints?

- Laura
Onboarding Lead — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@oakbridgehealth.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@oakbridgehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2026 15:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: MAP + capacity cadence for Oakbridge pilot

Looping in schedule and confirming resources:

- CS will support the 4-week pilot starting 06/15. Assigned engineer: Priya Natarajan (priya.natarajan@redwood.com) — will coordinate weekly checkpoints (Wednesdays).
- We'll provision the 8-GPU dev tranche on 06/14 (dry-run config) and hand off to Oakbridge on 06/15. I'll attach the GPU sizing sheet we used to size their workload.
- Procurement note for Sales: if Oakbridge signs before 06/12, we can hit the 06/15 pilot start; otherwise we should push pilot to the first available slot after provisioning completes.

Ben Carter
Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: gpu-sizing-sheet.xlsx
